channel.title: Kimani Upshur Daily Devotional
channel.description: A fresh Bible devotional every day from Kimani Upshur, M.Ed.

item.title: Daily Devotional: 2 Corinthians 9:7
item.description:
“Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.”

2 Corinthians 9:7 (KJV)

God does not want your reluctant leftovers; He loves a cheerful giver. Give from the heart, not from pressure, and watch joy multiply. Generosity is a privilege, not a tax.

Prayer: Father, make me a cheerful giver.

item.title: Daily Devotional: Philippians 3:14
item.description:
“I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.”

Philippians 3:14 (KJV)

The Christian life has a direction: forward and upward. Press toward the mark today; don't coast, don't drift, press.

Prayer: Father, help me press toward the mark of Your high calling today.

item.title: Daily Devotional: 1 Timothy 6:6
item.description:
“But godliness with contentment is great gain.”

1 Timothy 6:6 (KJV)

Real wealth isn't having more; it's wanting less and knowing God. Contentment plus godliness is the true jackpot.

Prayer: Lord, teach me to be content in You.

item.title: Daily Devotional: 2 Corinthians 3:17
item.description:
“Now the Lord is that Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.”

2 Corinthians 3:17 (KJV)

Where God's Spirit is, freedom follows: from guilt, from shame, from bondage. If you feel trapped today, invite His Spirit in. Liberty is His specialty.

Prayer: Lord, let Your Spirit bring me freedom.

item.title: Daily Devotional: Song of Solomon 2:4
item.description:
“He brought me to the banqueting house, and his banner over me was love.”

Song of Solomon 2:4 (KJV)

Picture it: God brings you to His table and hangs a banner of love over you. You are His honored guest, not a servant in the corner. Feast on His love today.

Prayer: Lord, thank You for covering me with Your banner of love.

item.title: Daily Devotional: 2 Thessalonians 3:3
item.description:
“But the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.”

2 Thessalonians 3:3 (KJV)

People may let you down, but the Lord never will. He's faithful to strengthen you and protect you from evil.

Prayer: Faithful Lord, I rest in Your protection.

item.title: Daily Devotional: 1 Corinthians 15:57
item.description:
“But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.”

1 Corinthians 15:57 (KJV)

Victory is not something you chase; it is something you are given through Christ. Thanks be to God! Walk today like a winner, because in Him, you are one.

Prayer: God, thank You for victory through Jesus Christ.
